title: How Roads Evolved 🛣️ From Mud Tracks to Highways #shorts #engineering
description:
Before roads, every rainy day turned travel into a mud trap. From the first stone streets in Mesopotamia to layered Roman roads, McAdam's crushed stone, the tarmac patent of 1902, and today's highways. Follow for more How It Evolved!
